title: Subjunctive mood after wish · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: The object clause after wish uses the subjunctive mood: past expresses a present wish, past perfect expresses past regret.本课为混合演练练习,核心:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。
points: wish + subject + past (a present wish)
wish + subject + past perfect (a past regret)
wish + could/would + base verb (a future wish)
were is used for all persons
if only = how I wish

examples.en: I wish I had more free time.
examples.zh: 真希望我有更多空闲时间。

examples.en: She wishes she had studied harder before.
examples.zh: 她真希望以前更努力学习。

examples.en: I wish I were as tall as my brother.
examples.zh: 真希望我和哥哥一样高。

examples.en: He wishes he could fly a plane.
examples.zh: 他真希望自己会开飞机。

examples.en: If only I had taken your advice!
examples.zh: 要是我听了你的建议就好了!

examples.en: We wish we had visited Sydney last year.
examples.zh: 真希望我们去年去了悉尼。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I wish I having more free time.
I wish I had more free time.
I wish I have more free time.
I wish I would have more free time.
questions.explanation: wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:I wish I had more free time.

questions.prompt: 「她真希望以前更努力学习。」的正确英文是?
options: She wishes she has studied harder before.
She wishes she would study harder before.
She wishes she studied harder before.
She wishes she had studied harder before.
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:She wishes she had studied harder before.

questions.prompt: I wish I _____ as tall as my brother.
options: was
will be
am
were
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 were。句意:真希望我和哥哥一样高。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: He wishes he could flew a plane.
He wishes he flew a plane.
He wishes he could fly a plane.
He wishes he can fly a plane.
questions.explanation: wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:He wishes he could fly a plane.

questions.prompt: 「要是我听了你的建议就好了!」的正确英文是?
options: If only I took your advice!
If only I have taken your advice!
If only I had taken your advice!
If only I would take your advice!
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:If only I had taken your advice!

questions.prompt: We wish we _____ Sydney last year.
options: would visit
visited
had visited
have visited
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 had visited。句意:真希望我们去年去了悉尼。

title: Subjunctive mood after suggest / insist · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: After suggest, insist, demand, order, the object clause uses (should) + base verb.本课为混合演练练习,核心:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。
points: suggest/insist/demand/order + (should) + base verb
should can be omitted
the negative is (should) not + base verb
the corresponding noun/adjective also take the base form
insist on 'insisting on a fact' takes the normal tense

examples.en: The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.
examples.zh: 医生建议他多锻炼。

examples.en: She insisted that we be there on time.
examples.zh: 她坚持要我们准时到。

examples.en: The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.
examples.zh: 老师要求今天交作业。

examples.en: It is important that everyone follow the rules.
examples.zh: 每个人都遵守规则很重要。

examples.en: He ordered that the work be finished at once.
examples.zh: 他命令立刻完成工作。

examples.en: My mother suggested that I not watch too much TV.
examples.zh: 我妈妈建议我不要看太多电视。

questions.prompt: 「医生建议他多锻炼。」的正确英文是?
options: The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.
The doctor suggested that he takes more exercise.
The doctor suggested that he took more exercise.
The doctor suggested that he taking more exercise.
questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.

questions.prompt: She insisted that we _____ there on time.
options: are
being
were
be
questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。此处应为 be。句意:她坚持要我们准时到。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: The teacher demanded that the homework been handed in today.
The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.
The teacher demanded that the homework is handed in today.
The teacher demanded that the homework was handed in today.
questions.explanation: Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.

questions.prompt: 「每个人都遵守规则很重要。」的正确英文是?
options: It is important that everyone following the rules.
It is important that everyone follow the rules.
It is important that everyone followed the rules.
It is important that everyone follows the rules.
questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:It is important that everyone follow the rules.

questions.prompt: He ordered that the work _____ at once.
options: be finished
was finished
is finished
been finished
questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。此处应为 be finished。句意:他命令立刻完成工作。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: My mother suggested that I not to watch too much TV.
My mother suggested that I didn't watch too much TV.
My mother suggested that I not watching too much TV.
My mother suggested that I not watch too much TV.
questions.explanation: Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:My mother suggested that I not watch too much TV.

title: Mixed subjunctive moods · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: Mixed subjunctive moods: the time referenced by the if clause differs from the main clause; choose the tense separately.本课为混合演练练习,核心:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。
points: past condition + present result
if + had done, main clause would do
present condition + past result is rare
judge the time by the context
were/was, had, should trigger inversion when if is omitted

examples.en: If I had taken that job, I would be in Sydney now.
examples.zh: 如果我当时接受那份工作,我现在就在悉尼了。

examples.en: If he hadn't missed the bus, he would be here now.
examples.zh: 如果他没错过公交车,他现在就在这里了。

examples.en: If I were smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
examples.zh: 如果我更聪明,昨天就把它解出来了。

examples.en: Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.
examples.zh: 如果你那时问我,我现在也会帮你。

examples.en: If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't be tired now.
examples.zh: 如果她早点睡,现在就不会累了。

examples.en: If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.
examples.zh: 如果我那时攒了钱,今天就能买了。

questions.prompt: If I had taken that job, I _____ in Sydney now.
options: had been
will be
would have been
would be
questions.explanation: 考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。此处应为 would be。句意:如果我当时接受那份工作,我现在就在悉尼了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If he wouldn't miss the bus, he would be here now.
If he hasn't missed the bus, he would be here now.
If he hadn't missed the bus, he would be here now.
If he didn't miss the bus, he would be here now.
questions.explanation: A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If he hadn't missed the bus, he would be here now.

questions.prompt: 「如果我更聪明,昨天就把它解出来了。」的正确英文是?
options: If I were smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
If I had been smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
If I was smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
If I would be smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
questions.explanation: 考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If I were smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.

questions.prompt: _____ me then, I would help you even now.
options: Had you asked
Did you ask
Have you asked
If you would ask
questions.explanation: 考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。此处应为 Had you asked。句意:如果你那时问我,我现在也会帮你。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If she had gone to bed early, she won't be tired now.
If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't have been tired now.
If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't be tired now.
If she had gone to bed early, she hadn't been tired now.
questions.explanation: A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't be tired now.

questions.prompt: 「如果我那时攒了钱,今天就能买了。」的正确英文是?
options: If I had saved money then, I had bought it today.
If I had saved money then, I can buy it today.
If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.
If I had saved money then, I could have bought it today.
questions.explanation: 考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.

title: Inversion with fronted negative words · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: Negative or semi-negative adverbs at the start of a sentence require partial inversion.本课为混合演练练习,核心:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。
points: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
Hardly had I arrived when it began to rain.
Not only did we lose, but we also got hurt.
Little did he know the truth.
the negative adverb determines the use of the auxiliary

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
examples.zh: 我从未见过这么美的日落。

examples.en: Hardly had we started when it began to rain.
examples.zh: 我们刚出发就开始下雨了。

examples.en: Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.
examples.zh: 他不仅工作努力,还很善良。

examples.en: Little did she know that the answer was wrong.
examples.zh: 她一点也不知道答案是错的。

examples.en: Not once has he been late this year.
examples.zh: 今年他一次也没迟到过。

examples.en: Seldom do we see such old buildings now.
examples.zh: 我们现在很少见到这么老的建筑了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
Never I saw such a beautiful sunset.
Never I have seen such a beautiful sunset.
Never did I saw such a beautiful sunset.
questions.explanation: Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.

questions.prompt: 「我们刚出发就开始下雨了。」的正确英文是?
options: Hardly had we started when it began to rain.
Hardly we started when it began to rain.
Hardly we had started when it began to rain.
Hardly did we start when it began to rain.
questions.explanation: 考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Hardly had we started when it began to rain.

questions.prompt: Not only _____ hard, but he is also kind.
options: does he work
he works
he does work
works he
questions.explanation: 考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 does he work。句意:他不仅工作努力,还很善良。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Little knew she that the answer was wrong.
Little she knew that the answer was wrong.
Little she did know that the answer was wrong.
Little did she know that the answer was wrong.
questions.explanation: Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Little did she know that the answer was wrong.

questions.prompt: 「今年他一次也没迟到过。」的正确英文是?
options: Not once has he been late this year.
Not once did he was late this year.
Not once he has been late this year.
Not once he was late this year.
questions.explanation: 考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Not once has he been late this year.

questions.prompt: Seldom _____ such old buildings now.
options: we see
we do see
do we see
see we
questions.explanation: 考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 do we see。句意:我们现在很少见到这么老的建筑了。

title: only + adverbial inversion · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: When only + adverbial (time/condition) is fronted, partial inversion is used; only modifying the subject does not invert.本课为混合演练练习,核心:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。
points: Only then did I understand.
Only in this way can we solve it.
Only when the rain stopped did we go out.
only modifying the subject does not invert: Only Tom knows.
the inversion occurs in the clause after only

examples.en: Only then did I understand his words.
examples.zh: 直到那时我才明白他的话。

examples.en: Only in this way can we finish the work on time.
examples.zh: 只有这样我们才能按时完成工作。

examples.en: Only when the teacher came did they stop talking.
examples.zh: 直到老师来了他们才停止交谈。

examples.en: Only at night does the city become quiet.
examples.zh: 只有到了夜里这座城市才安静下来。

examples.en: Only after the meeting did he call me.
examples.zh: 直到会议结束后他才给我打电话。

examples.en: Only with your help can I pass the exam.
examples.zh: 只有靠你的帮助我才能通过考试。

questions.prompt: 「直到那时我才明白他的话。」的正确英文是?
options: Only then I did understand his words.
Only then understood I his words.
Only then I understood his words.
Only then did I understand his words.
questions.explanation: 考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only then did I understand his words.

questions.prompt: Only in this way _____ the work on time.
options: finish we can
can we finish
we finish can
we can finish
questions.explanation: 考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 can we finish。句意:只有这样我们才能按时完成工作。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Only when the teacher came did they stop talking.
Only when the teacher came they stopped talking.
Only when the teacher came stopped they talking.
Only when the teacher came they did stop talking.
questions.explanation: Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only when the teacher came did they stop talking.

questions.prompt: 「只有到了夜里这座城市才安静下来。」的正确英文是?
options: Only at night becomes the city quiet.
Only at night the city becomes quiet.
Only at night the city does become quiet.
Only at night does the city become quiet.
questions.explanation: 考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only at night does the city become quiet.

questions.prompt: Only after the meeting _____ me.
options: he did call
did he call
he called
called he
questions.explanation: 考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 did he call。句意:直到会议结束后他才给我打电话。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Only with your help I pass can the exam.
Only with your help pass I can the exam.
Only with your help can I pass the exam.
Only with your help I can pass the exam.
questions.explanation: Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only with your help can I pass the exam.

title: so / neither partial inversion · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: so/neither indicates 'the same is true (not)' and takes partial inversion, avoiding repetition.本课为混合演练练习,核心:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。
points: So do I = I do too
Neither do I = I don't either
the auxiliary matches the previous sentence
So + subject + auxiliary means indeed so (no inversion)
the tense agrees with the previous sentence

examples.en: I like traveling, and so does my sister.
examples.zh: 我喜欢旅行,我妹妹也是。

examples.en: He can't drive, and neither can I.
examples.zh: 他不会开车,我也不会。

examples.en: They went to the museum, and so did we.
examples.zh: 他们去了博物馆,我们也去了。

examples.en: I have never been to Sydney, and neither has he.
examples.zh: 我没去过悉尼,他也没去过。

examples.en: She is a nurse, and so am I.
examples.zh: 她是护士,我也是。

examples.en: You won't give up, and neither shall we.
examples.zh: 你们不会放弃,我们也不会。

questions.prompt: I like traveling, and _____ my sister.
options: so is
so does
does so
so do
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 so does。句意:我喜欢旅行,我妹妹也是。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: He can't drive, and neither do I.
He can't drive, and neither can I.
He can't drive, and can neither I.
He can't drive, and neither can't I.
questions.explanation: so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:He can't drive, and neither can I.

questions.prompt: 「他们去了博物馆,我们也去了。」的正确英文是?
options: They went to the museum, and so do we.
They went to the museum, and did so we.
They went to the museum, and so did we.
They went to the museum, and so were we.
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:They went to the museum, and so did we.

questions.prompt: I have never been to Sydney, and _____ he.
options: neither haven't
neither has
neither does
has neither
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 neither has。句意:我没去过悉尼,他也没去过。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She is a nurse, and so is I.
She is a nurse, and am so I.
She is a nurse, and so am I.
She is a nurse, and so do I.
questions.explanation: so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:She is a nurse, and so am I.

questions.prompt: 「你们不会放弃,我们也不会。」的正确英文是?
options: You won't give up, and neither shall we.
You won't give up, and neither will not we.
You won't give up, and neither do we.
You won't give up, and shall neither we.
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:You won't give up, and neither shall we.

title: Cleft sentences It is...that · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: Cleft sentences emphasize the subject, object or adverbial: It is...that/who..., the tense stays unchanged.本课为混合演练练习,核心:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。
points: emphasizing a person: It is...who...
emphasizing a time/place adverbial: It was...that...
not the predicate can be emphasized
the cleft sentence does not change the sentence's meaning
distinguished from the formal subject It is...that

examples.en: It was Tom who broke the window.
examples.zh: 是汤姆打破了窗户。

examples.en: It is English that we practice every morning.
examples.zh: 我们每天早上练的是英语。

examples.en: It was in January that they first met.
examples.zh: 他们是在一月初次见面的。

examples.en: It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
examples.zh: 每天给我们做饭的是我妈妈。

examples.en: It was at the station that I lost my bag.
examples.zh: 我是在车站丢的包。

examples.en: It is hard work that leads to success.
examples.zh: 是努力通向成功。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: It was Tom that whom broke the window.
It was Tom which broke the window.
It was Tom whom broke the window.
It was Tom who broke the window.
questions.explanation: It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It was Tom who broke the window.

questions.prompt: 「我们每天早上练的是英语。」的正确英文是?
options: It is English who we practice every morning.
It is English which we practice every morning.
It is English that we practice every morning.
It is English what we practice every morning.
questions.explanation: 考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It is English that we practice every morning.

questions.prompt: It was in January _____ they first met.
options: that
which
what
when
questions.explanation: 考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。此处应为 that。句意:他们是在一月初次见面的。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
It is my mother which cooks for us every day.
It is my mother whom cooks for us every day.
It is my mother whose cooks for us every day.
questions.explanation: It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It is my mother who cooks for us every day.

questions.prompt: 「我是在车站丢的包。」的正确英文是?
options: It was at the station which I lost my bag.
It was at the station when I lost my bag.
It was at the station that I lost my bag.
It was at the station where I lost my bag.
questions.explanation: 考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It was at the station that I lost my bag.

questions.prompt: It is hard work _____ leads to success.
options: what
who
which
that
questions.explanation: 考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。此处应为 that。句意:是努力通向成功。

title: Formal subject it · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: it acts as formal subject, replacing the real subject (infinitive or clause) placed later.本课为混合演练练习,核心:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。
points: It is important to learn English.
It takes time to master a skill.
It is said that... reportedly
It is + adjective + for sb to do
It is kind of sb to do (evaluating a person's character uses of)

examples.en: It is important to keep a diary in English.
examples.zh: 用英语写日记很重要。

examples.en: It takes about an hour to get to the library.
examples.zh: 到图书馆大约需要一个小时。

examples.en: It is said that the bridge has a long history.
examples.zh: 据说这座桥历史悠久。

examples.en: It is necessary for us to take notes in class.
examples.zh: 我们有必要在课堂上记笔记。

examples.en: It is kind of you to help me with music.
examples.zh: 你帮我学音乐,真是太好了。

examples.en: It is no use crying over spilt milk.
examples.zh: 事后后悔是没有用的。

questions.prompt: 「用英语写日记很重要。」的正确英文是?
options: It is important keep a diary in English.
It is important to keep a diary in English.
It is important keeping a diary in English.
It is important to keeping a diary in English.
questions.explanation: 考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is important to keep a diary in English.

questions.prompt: It takes about an hour _____ to the library.
options: to get
get
to getting
getting
questions.explanation: 考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。此处应为 to get。句意:到图书馆大约需要一个小时。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: It says that the bridge has a long history.
It is said that the bridge has a long history.
That is said the bridge has a long history.
It is say that the bridge has a long history.
questions.explanation: It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is said that the bridge has a long history.

questions.prompt: 「我们有必要在课堂上记笔记。」的正确英文是?
options: It is necessary for us to take notes in class.
It is necessary us to take notes in class.
It is necessary for us taking notes in class.
It is necessary of us to take notes in class.

examples.en: Only at night does the city become quiet.
examples.zh: 只有到了夜里这座城市才安静下来。

examples.en: Only after the meeting did he call me.
examples.zh: 直到会议结束后他才给我打电话。

examples.en: Only with your help can I pass the exam.
examples.zh: 只有靠你的帮助我才能通过考试。

questions.prompt: 「直到那时我才明白他的话。」的正确英文是?
options: Only then I did understand his words.
Only then understood I his words.
Only then did I understand his words.
Only then I understood his words.
questions.explanation: 考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only then did I understand his words.
